title: A1 Writing Quiz 9 — School, Family & Free Time

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + object + time: 'I eat breakfast every morning.'

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
options: My sister studies at a university.
My sister at a university studies.
Studies my sister at a university.
At a university my sister studies.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + place: 'My sister studies at a university.'

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + object: 'He has a new bicycle.'

questions.question: Choose the correct question word order.
questions.explanation: Wh-word + auxiliary + subject + verb: 'Where do you live?'

questions.question: Which sentence uses capital letters correctly?
questions.explanation: Languages (English), days of the week (Mondays), and 'I' are always capitalized.

questions.question: Choose the correctly capitalized sentence.
options: my family lives in ganja, azerbaijan.
My family lives in Ganja, Azerbaijan.
My Family lives in ganja, Azerbaijan.
my family lives in Ganja, azerbaijan.
questions.explanation: City names (Ganja) and country names (Azerbaijan) are proper nouns and must be capitalized.

questions.question: Which sentence has correct punctuation?
questions.explanation: A simple statement ends with a full stop: 'I have two brothers.'

questions.question: Which sentence has correct punctuation?
questions.explanation: A question ends with a question mark: 'Do you have any pets?'

questions.question: Choose the sentence with correct commas.
options: I like maths science and art.
I like maths, science and art.
I like, maths science, and art.
I like maths, science, and, art.
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list: 'maths, science and art.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: 'It's' is the contraction of 'It is'.

questions.question: My teacher ___ us homework every day.
questions.explanation: Present simple with 'teacher' (he/she) takes -s: 'gives'.

questions.question: I ___ at my grandmother's house last weekend.
questions.explanation: 'Last weekend' signals past simple; past of 'am' is 'was'.

questions.question: Listen! The children ___ in the garden.
questions.explanation: 'Listen!' signals an action happening now → present continuous: 'are playing'.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'and'.
options: I like reading and I like drawing.
I like reading and but drawing.
questions.explanation: 'And' joins two similar activities: 'I like reading and I like drawing.'

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'but'.
options: My brother is tall but thin.
My brother is tall and but thin.
But my brother is tall thin.
My brother, thin but is tall.
questions.explanation: 'But' shows contrast: 'My brother is tall but thin.'

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'so'.
options: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
So I was tired I went to bed early.
I was tired I went so to bed early.
So, went I to bed tired early.
questions.explanation: 'So' introduces a result: 'I was tired, so I went to bed early.'

questions.question: The library is ___ the school and the park.
questions.explanation: 'Between' describes a position among two things: 'between the school and the park.'

questions.question: We usually do our homework ___ the evening.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used with parts of the day: 'in the evening.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: 'Umbrella' starts with a vowel sound /ʌ/ → 'an umbrella.'

questions.question: Which is the correct way to start a message telling a friend about your new pet?
questions.explanation: 'Hi [Name],' is the correct informal greeting for a friend.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to end a message inviting a friend to your birthday party?
questions.explanation: 'See you soon, [Name]' is a friendly, informal closing suitable for a friend.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to start a formal email requesting information from a school?
questions.explanation: 'Dear Mrs./Mr. [Surname],' is a respectful, semi-formal opening when the name is known.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly combines 'I like football.' and 'I like basketball.'?
options: I like football, I like basketball.
questions.explanation: Two related likes can be joined simply: 'I like football and basketball.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: She has a leather black bag.
She has a black leather bag.
She has black a leather bag.
She has a bag black leather.
questions.explanation: Opinion/color adjectives come before material: 'a black leather bag.'

questions.question: Which sentence correctly shows excitement?
questions.explanation: An exclamation mark shows strong feeling of excitement: 'We won the school competition!'

questions.question: ___ many students in my class.
questions.explanation: 'Many students' is plural → 'There are'.

questions.question: This is ___ notebook. (belongs to my classmate)
questions.explanation: Singular possessive: add apostrophe + s → "classmate's notebook".

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses sequencing words.
options: First, I do my homework. Then, I watch TV.
First I do homework then watch TV.
Watch TV first then do I homework.
Then first, I do the watch homework TV.
questions.explanation: Sequencing words like 'First,' and 'Then,' organize steps clearly with commas.

questions.question: My parents and my brother ___ at home.
questions.explanation: Compound subject ('My parents and my brother') is plural → 'are'.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Wh-phrase + auxiliary + subject + verb: 'What subject do you like?'
